The template is `MERGE (incident:IncidentRoutingEvidence {uid: row.incident_uid}) ... MERGE (routing:IncidentRoutingEvidence {uid: row.uid}) ... MERGE (incident)-[rel:%s]->(routing)`, and the %s is filled per closed routing slot from incidentRoutingSlotRelationshipTypes: intended_routing -> HAS_INTENDED_ROUTING, applied_routing -> HAS_APPLIED_ROUTING, live_routing -> HAS_LIVE_ROUTING. Both endpoints are :IncidentRoutingEvidence matched by uid, so the source below is the incident uid = facts.StableID(IncidentRoutingEvidence, {node_kind: incident, scope_id: pagerduty:eshu-fixture-incident-routing, provider: pagerduty, provider_incident_id: PINCIDENT6228}) and each target is the routing row uid = facts.StableID(IncidentRoutingEvidence, {node_kind: routing, incident_uid, slot, source_class, evidence_kind, evidence_id}) with evidence kinds content_entity.PagerDutyDeclaration / incident_routing.applied_pagerduty_resource / incident_routing.observed_pagerduty_service and evidence ids declared-entity-6228 / applied-fact-6228 / observed-fact-6228. The relationship MERGEs on its two endpoints alone, so there is no identity block; slot, source_class, and truth_label are SET after the MERGE and are asserted here as mutable properties instead. Exactly three edges: the Odù's one incident anchor converges declared/applied/observed exact across the shared Checkout API service (declaration literal via the production HCL parser, applied and observed joined on PSERVICE6228 with matching PEP1 escalation references). The Odù's fourth fact is a tombstoned duplicate applied envelope that the builder skips before decoding, so it contributes no edge on purpose. evidence_source, scope_id, and generation_id are stamped by the WRITER from per-run intent arguments (or its compile-time constant), not carried on the extractor rows, so no static set pins them; their stamping is covered by the cypher writer unit test asserting the annotated row contents instead.
